_description: Model and default effort per worker role. Top-level roles configure Codex workers. The claude block configures Claude workers. Both lead clients install this file. Per-machine overrides go in models.local.json (gitignored, same shape, any subset of roles/fields). Valid Codex efforts: none, minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh.

claude._description: Claude workers (claude-delegate.mjs): auth is subscription (the user's own Claude Code login, default) or api (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, --bare). ORCH_CLAUDE_AUTH and ORCH_CLAUDE_MODEL override auth and every role's model. Valid efforts: low, medium, high, xhigh, max.
